58. MARRIAGE ASSISTANCE TO NORMAL PERSONS MARRYING SPEECH 
AND  
HEARING   IMPAIRED PERSONS 
 
1. 
 
Gist of the Scheme 
Marriage assistance is given to normal person 
marrying speech and hearing   impaired persons . 
 
Total assistance given is Rs.25,000/-; Rs.12,500/- 
is given in the form of National Savings Certificate 
and Rs.12,500/- as cheque or Demand Draft  
towards marriage expenses along with a certificate 
of appreciation and   8 gram gold coin for making 
Tirumangalyam from 23.05.2016. 
 
If either  the differently abled person or normal 
person holding degree or diploma, the marriage 
assistance amount is Rs.50,000/-; Rs.25,000/- in the 
form of National  Saving Certificate  and  
Rs.25,000/- in the form of cheque or Demand Draft 
with  8 gram gold coin for making  Tirumangalyam. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Normal person should marry a speech and 
hearing   impaired person.  The age of the 
couple (both) should be above 18 years. 
3. 
Whether  the prescribed 
application form is available 
Yes. Prescribed formats are available with District 
Differently Abled Welfare Office. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
National   identity card   for   differently   abled   
and certificate of proof for marriage and age. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application 
is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
6. 
Grievances if any to 
be addressed to 
Assistant Director (DAW), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
